author: ValWood
body:
**UniProt UniRule (ID and label):**

IEA with SL-0169

**Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
All cym1 (and orthologs, eg)
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC119.17

**Description of issue**
In S. cerevisiae, Cym1 (also known as Mop112) is a mitochondrial protein. There was initially some debate about its exact sub-mitochondrial location — early work reported Cym1 in the intermembrane space (IMS) ScienceDirect, but more recent studies revisiting its submitochondrial localization established that endogenous Cym1/Mop112 is localized to the mitochondrial matrix, consistent with the localization of its plant and human homologues.
title: Subcellular Location GO:0005758 mitochondrial intermembrane space IEA with SL-0169
